def check_ip(ip_str):
    pattern = r"\b(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\.(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\.(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\.(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\b"
    if re.match(pattern, ip_str):
        return True
    else:
        return False

#主程序
os.system("title 网卡叠加-www.slll.info&&color 18")

    while True:
